adapters.name: Latency Measurement (Local Qualification Fixture)
adapters.description: LOCAL QUALIFICATION FIXTURE ONLY. Measures TCP connection latency to a declared target endpoint and produces a signed contribution receipt. This is not integration with any external DePIN provider. It exists solely to exercise and qualify the full adapter pipeline: catalog → compatibility → consent → execution → observation → verification → receipt → mobile inspection → export. Do not present receipts from this adapter as provider-acknowledged contribution.

operations.description: Measure TCP connection latency to a declared reachable endpoint. Records measured round-trip time, observation timestamp, and source. Does not infer any reward or real DePIN contribution.
Export the signed contribution receipt for the most recent latency-measure operation.

contributionMeasurement.method: TCP dial to declared endpoint; measured wall-clock duration in microseconds.
contributionMeasurement.verificationMethod: Node re-executes dial to same endpoint and compares result to declared receipt; deviation within 5x accepted.
contributionMeasurement.notes: LOCAL_OBSERVATION elevated to NODE_SIGNED_RECORD by node-agent Ed25519 signature over the receipt. Not independently verified by a third party. Not a real DePIN contribution.

qualificationStatus.notes: Qualified through the full adapter pipeline using local fixture only. No external provider interaction.

skrIntegration.reason: This is a local qualification fixture with no provider integration. SKR integration does not apply.
